description: Temporal metadata model for causality and timeline reasoning. Enables time-aware graph traversal and consequence chain detection.

relationshipTemporalExtensions.description: Optional temporal fields to add to relationships in schema-curation.json

startDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this relationship became active or was observed

endDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this relationship ended. null = ongoing/undefined

observedDate.description: When this relationship was discovered/confirmed (may differ from startDate)

confidence.description: Temporal confidence: how certain is the timing? 0.1=guessed, 1.0=exact timestamp

lag.description: ISO 8601 duration representing delay between cause and effect. e.g., P7D = 7 days, PT2H = 2 hours

causedBy.description: Events or decisions that triggered this relationship. References: schema:id format

causesEvents.description: Events or outcomes this relationship triggered. Downstream consequences.

sequenceNumber.description: Position in a causal chain (0=root, 1=first consequence, etc.)

commenced.description: For activities (projects, events): when they started

effectiveFrom.description: For decisions, goals: when they became active

validUntil.description: For time-limited entities (contracts, permissions): expiration date

temporalReasoningPatterns.name: Decision → Outcome Tracing
temporalReasoningPatterns.description: Track decision to outcome with full timeline
temporalReasoningPatterns.query: What outcomes resulted from this decision?

temporalReasoningPatterns.name: Impact Timeline
temporalReasoningPatterns.description: When did an event cascade through the system?
temporalReasoningPatterns.query: What entities were affected by this event, and when?

temporalReasoningPatterns.name: Root Cause Analysis
temporalReasoningPatterns.description: What caused this failure? Trace backwards through chain.
temporalReasoningPatterns.query: What is the root cause of this outcome?
temporalReasoningPatterns.temporalOrdering: Reverse chronological: failure.date > priorFailure.date > earlierEvent.date > rootCause.date

temporalReasoningPatterns.name: Predictive Impact
temporalReasoningPatterns.description: If we make this decision, what might happen?
temporalReasoningPatterns.query: What entities might be affected if we proceed with this decision?
temporalReasoningPatterns.temporalOrdering: Future projection from decision date forward
temporalReasoningPatterns.constraints: Only use positive-outcome and conditional relationships

temporalReasoningPatterns.name: Milestone Sequencing
temporalReasoningPatterns.description: What is the optimal sequence of milestones?
temporalReasoningPatterns.query: In what order should milestones be completed?

queries.name: What led to this outcome?
queries.sql: TRACE BACKWARDS FROM Outcome ALONG causes UNTIL maxHops=5 WHERE confidence > 0.7

queries.name: What events were caused by this decision?
queries.sql: TRACE FORWARDS FROM Decision ALONG causesEvents UNTIL confidence < 0.5

queries.name: Timeline of Event between dates?
queries.sql: FIND ALL relationships WHERE startDate >= '2026-01-01' AND endDate <= '2026-12-31'

queries.name: Which decisions led to this outcome within 6 months?
queries.sql: TRACE Decision → Outcome WHERE lag < P180D

rules.name: Non-negative duration
rules.constraint: If exists(startDate) AND exists(endDate), then endDate >= startDate

rules.name: Causal ordering
rules.constraint: If A causes B, then A.date < B.date (or equal if simultaneous)

rules.name: No future causality
rules.constraint: Causes must predate effects. If causedBy=[event], then event.date < relationship.startDate

rules.name: Consistent lags
rules.constraint: If lag='P5D' and startDate and causedBy[0].date exist, verify startDate ≈ causedBy.date + 5 days

temporalAggregationFunctions.description: Functions for combining temporal data in chains

lag.description: Total duration from root cause to final outcome
lag.example: Payment failure (Jan 15) to Goal blocked (Feb 01) = P17D

confidence_decay.description: Confidence drops as we move further from root cause
confidence_decay.example: 0.95 confidence at hop 0, 0.86 at hop 1, 0.77 at hop 2

strength_decay.description: Relationship strength fades through long chains
strength_decay.example: 0.9 strength at hop 0, 0.86 at hop 1, 0.81 at hop 2

impact_magnitude.description: Total impact of root cause across chain
